summary_paragraph: The patient was admitted due to nausea, inability to tolerate oral intake, and dehydration two weeks after a gastric bypass reversal. She reported bilious vomiting and dizziness upon standing, with minimal oral intake over the prior 24 hours. She was started on IV fluids and transitioned from a bariatric stage 3 diet to a mechanical soft diet after associating nausea with protein shakes. No signs of infection were found on stool studies, and labs remained stable. Her pain was well controlled with acetaminophen, and she ambulated without difficulty. By discharge, she was tolerating oral intake, afebrile, and hemodynamically stable. She was discharged home with instructions to continue the mechanical soft diet, crush all medications, avoid NSAIDs, and use Compazine as needed for nausea. Follow-up was arranged to monitor recovery.
